Name: Summer Animals
Author: KediDili
TagLine: This mod is made for Stardew Valley Discord server's 2021 Summer event.
Description:
This mod is made for Stardew Valley Discord server's 2021 Summer event.

Requires BFAV mod (Better Farm Animal Variety)
Since the official version is broken for 1.5, here's the link to unofficial update: https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-47#post-29740

This mod adds 3 different coop animals to the game that resemble three different teams in the Summer event.

ChickFern: Resembles Fiddlehead Friends, gives normal egg and fiddlehead ferns
Cherry Bunny: Resembles Cherry Chums, gives wool and cherries
StarDuck: Resembles Shooting Starfruits, gives duck eggs and starfruits

   Additional Credit
-- Pillow (For doing the BFAV coding!)

   If You Encounter A Bug
-- Upload your log to https://smapi.io/log and report it from Bugs section. Add a photo if it is something visual.
